description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Amen Corner”, a sophisticated vacation rental in downtown Rosemary Beach. Just steps from Barrett Square and overlooking Eastern Long Green Park, this beautifully renovated home offers a large balcony, access to 4 community pools, and 2 private parking spots. Enjoy the comforts of a chef’s kitchen, spacious living areas filled with natural light, and easy walking distance to shops, restaurants, and sugar-white sandy beaches. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Location: Just a 1-minute walk to Barrett Square and minutes from the white sand shores of Rosemary BeachExpansive Balcony: Relax in style with a custom bed swing and cozy seating, offering stunning views of Eastern Long Green ParkStunning Renovations: Completely updated with luxury finishes, thoughtful design, high-end furnishings, and modern touches throughout4 Rosemary Beach Pools: Enjoy access to 4 beautiful pools, including a heated option, all within a 5-minute walkChef’s Dream Kitchen: Featuring quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, a spacious layout, and a breakfast bar with seating for 45-Minute Walk to Fitness Center and Tennis Courts: Convenient access to stay active and enjoy recreational amenities nearbyEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Perfectly located and beautifully appointed! It was our home away from home. We’ll definitely return!" – Tim K.⭐"This was the most stunning home I’ve stayed in. Amazing balcony views and a stone's throw from Barrett Square!" – Claire W.⭐"The porch swing was a favorite—we spent every evening there with a glass of wine. Highly recommend!" – Reagan H.*** LIVING AREAS ***Breathe in the Gulf breeze from beautifully designed living spaces flooded with natural light. With 11-foot ceilings, pecan wood floors, and an open-concept layout, this home offers plenty of room for relaxation and connection with loved ones.Spacious living room with cozy seating and charming furnishingsOpen floor plan for seamless entertainingStunning Balcony featuring panoramic Eastern Long Green Park views and a bed swing*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Designed for the gourmet chef or casual cook, the kitchen is as functional as it is stunning. Equipped with premium finishes and appliances, it provides everything you need for any culinary adventure.Beautiful quartz countertops and white cabinetsStainless steel appliances, including a full-sized refrigerator and stoveBreakfast bar seating for 4Round dining table for 8 guestsAccess to balcony with outdoor dining for 8Propane grill for al fresco dining on the porch*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st FloorPrimary Suite: King-size bed, walk-in closet, and en-suite bath with tiled shower and double sinks. Includes access to a private courtyard. The suite also hosts Bunk nook with Full-over-Full bedBunk Room: Two twin-over-king bunks with en-suite bath and walk-in shower.2nd FloorGuest Room: King-size bed and adjoining bath with subway tile tub/shower combo.Living Room: Sofa option available to accommodate additional guests.*** ROSEMARY BEACH COMMUNITY ***Perfectly situated just 1 minute from Barrett Square, everything you need is within a short walk. Enjoy casual and fine dining, boutique shopping, and scenic pathways. The renowned Rosemary Beach white sand beach is just a stone's throw away. Plus, access to 4 pristine community pools ensures that relaxation is always within reach.Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architectureRacquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spotsMultiple parks & greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountainsFitness Center with massage and yoga4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased during checkout or independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 59162STRO #: STR-059162

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
